featured_reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, my experience with this zoology teacher has been quite disappointing. There are frequent mood swings and an evident ego issue, where even respectful disagreement from students is not tolerated, regardless of whether the student is correct. Education should build confidence and curiosity, not fear or self-doubt. I hope this feedback is taken constructively to improve the overall teaching approach and student experience.

featured_reviews.name: virendra sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with my experience at PW Vidyapeeth Borivali. When I enrolled, the institute promised high-quality teaching, proper academic support, and a structured environment for serious exam preparation. Unfortunately, the reality has been very different from what was promised.

The teaching faculty is not up to the level required for competitive exam preparation. Many classes lack depth in concepts, and the explanations often feel incomplete or rushed. Another major issue is that several services and academic support systems that were promised during admission are either poorly implemented or not provided properly. Students expect guidance, doubt-solving sessions. I request one who see this review please don't waste your money by enrolling in borivali vidyapeeth instead purchase the online batch.
